item.title: Renting vs Buying: How to Decide in 2026
item.description:
Introduction

The renting versus buying question is usually argued as though one answer is correct in general. It is not. The right answer depends on how long you stay, what housing costs in the city you are moving to, and how much of your savings you are willing to keep illiquid.

In 2026 the calculation is more sensitive than it has been in recent years, because mortgage rates, home prices, and rents have not moved together. Treating the decision as a comparison of monthly payments alone produces the wrong answer often enough to be expensive.
